elements.name: Journeyman Conductor
elements.desc:
You have spent some time in the bardic teachings of a maestro, granting you minor command over the music of combat. You gain the following benefits.

- You learn 2 conducting techniques of your choice from among those available to the College of the Maestro in the bard class. If a technique you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the technique's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.
- If you already have Bardic Inspiration dice, you gain one more; otherwise, you have one Bardic Inspiration die, which is a d6. This die can be given to others as a bonus action (per the bard feature, Bardic Inspiration), or can be used to fuel your techniques. A Bardic Inspiration die is expended when you use it. You regain this expended bardic inspiration die when you finish a short or long rest.
